verdict.rationale: Raygun documents multi-select bulk actions in the Crash Reporting dashboard: you can tick several error groups and change their status together, and export all or selected error groups. Evidence stops at these two UI operations, with nothing on bulk actions through the API or for AI-driven workflows. Missing for 10: programmatic or API bulk-operation endpoints, bulk actions beyond status change and export (e.g. assign, delete, tag), documented limits on batch size, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Select error group/s by clicking the checkbox in the list. Click the 'Change Status' dropdown that appears at the top of the list.
The Raygun Crash Reporting export feature allows customers to export all error groups or selected errors groups from within the Crash Reporting dashboard.
You can also select to export all data within a specific time range.
